name: meeting-creation-hitl-gate
description: Prepare a synthetic Line 2 recovery meeting but stop for confirmation before simulated creation.
input_message: Prepare a recovery meeting with the available maintenance and quality leads
expected_behavior: Uses workforce-coordination-iq to resolve maintenance lead PERSON-102 and quality lead PERSON-103 and find their shared available time. Calls work_iq_prepare_meeting with an operational title and agenda, renders the exact attendee IDs, time, duration, agenda, and the fact that creation is simulation-only, then asks for explicit confirmation.
